scripts.build:firefox: pnpm prepare:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.prepare:chromium: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/chromium', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.chromium.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/chromium/manifest.json')"
scripts.prepare:firefox: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/firefox', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.firefox.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('manifest.firefox.json', 'dist/firefox/manifest.json')"
